page.overview:
Who is Demise?

Demise is an antagonistic character that appears in , serving as the Final Boss of the game. He is a Demon King and the master of Ghirahim, its primary antagonist. He is responsible for every incarnation of Ganon, and every conflict that he, Link, and Princess Zelda collectively waged in The Legend of Zelda series.

Eons before the events of , he and his army of demons broke through a fissure in the earth and sought out the Triforce. After a long war, he was eventually sealed away by the Goddess Hylia. He is resurrected during the events of the game, but is defeated by Link through the use of the Master Sword. However, upon his ultimate defeat, Demise utters a deadly curse stating that his hatred will not end, but will be reborn in an eternal cycle. Therefore, it's likely Demise is in fact the original incarnation of The Legend of Zelda's main villain.

Demise was an eternal entity who had conquered time itself. When the Golden Goddesses departed from the world, they trusted their ultimate power, the Triforce, in the hands of Hylia to protect it. However, Demise, wanting the Triforce to make the world his own, gathered an army of monsters and together launched an attack against the people of the Surface, murdering them and causing misfortunes to get their hands on the power guarded by Hylia.

To prevent this great power from falling into the hands of Demise, Hylia and the five tribes who lived on the Surface joined forces and fought back against the Demon King and his forces in a war, which would end with Demise sealed away and peace restored to the land. Due to the seal placed upon him, he assumes the monstrous form as "The Imprisoned" for the majority of the plot.
